title: PDNI memo waives UAP NDAs
place_text: Office of the Director of National Intelligence, US

tellings.quote: okay, Aaron Lucas just sent out a memo >> per the president's directive saying that if anybody has information regarding UAP and they had to sign an NDA that the NDAs will be waved

plain: In 2026, Aaron Lucas, the second-ranking official in the office of the Director of National Intelligence, is said to have sent a memo, "per the president's directive," saying that anyone with information about UAP, the government's term for UFOs, who had signed a non-disclosure agreement would have that agreement waived. Tim Gallaudet, a retired Navy admiral, tells Michels about the memo as news just sent out. If true, it would free people sworn to secrecy to speak about what they know.
